# Marilla Cuthbert

## Overview

- **Age:** 50  <sub>[v1 c9 P44](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0044)</sub>
- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 c1 P13](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0013)</sub>
- **Origin:** Avonlea  <sub>[v1 c8 P11](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0011), [v1 c34 P5](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0005)</sub>
- **Titles:** Miss Cuthbert  <sub>[v1 c6 P5](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0005), [v1 c8 P11](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0011)</sub>

## Appearance

Marilla is a tall, thin woman with sharp angles, lack of curves, and dark hair showing gray streaks that is always twisted up in a hard knot with wire hairpins. Over time her hair grays further, but her face grows softer. As a small child, she was a dark, homely girl.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P13](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0013), [v1 c9 P44](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0044), [v1 c33 P15](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0015)_

## Personality

Marilla is a sensible, practical, and stern woman of narrow experience and rigid conscience. She maintains a stoic and self-contained exterior, finding it difficult to express affection open-facedly or in words. She possesses a dry sense of humor and is prone to self-criticism as well as strict discipline. Over time, she develops a deep and tender soft-heartedness toward Anne while continuing to hide her immense pride in her.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P13](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0013), [v1 c9 P12](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0012), [v1 c12 P46](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0046), [v1 c13 P11](../source/v01-c13.md#nw-v01-c13-p0011), [v1 c22 P3](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0003), [v1 c23 P25](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0025), [v1 c26 P1](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0001), [v1 c30 P3](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0003), [v1 c32 P47](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0047)_

## History

Marilla lives at Green Gables in Avonlea alongside her brother Matthew. Though initially intending to adopt an orphan boy to assist with farm duties, they receive an orphan girl, Anne Shirley, due to a mistake. Marilla decides to keep and raise Anne, setting out to train her to be useful and well-behaved. She experiences numerous trials with Anne's whimsical blunders, including a lost amethyst brooch and accidental wine-serving, but gradually grows deeply attached to her. Over the years, Marilla remains active in local affairs like the Aid Society meetings. As Anne grows up and succeeds in her studies, Marilla silently takes pride in her while managing household matters and monitoring Matthew's failing heart health. After experiencing trouble with her eyes, she arranges to visit a specialist in town.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P7](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0007), [v1 c3 P1](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0001), [v1 c6 P34](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0034), [v1 c8 P5](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0005), [v1 c12 P46](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0046), [v1 c14 P22](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0022), [v1 c16 P5](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0005), [v1 c16 P46](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0046), [v1 c30 P3](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0003), [v1 c30 P38](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0038), [v1 c32 P47](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0047), [v1 c34 P5](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0005), [v1 c37 P28](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0028)_

- Was grown up when the new house at Green Gables was built  <sub>[v1 c1 P31](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0031)</sub>
